title: English Practice Quiz 0709
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Water ___ at 100°C at sea level.
questions.explanation: Use the present simple for general facts.

questions.question: A visitor asks, 'Where is reception?' You say:
options: It is near the main entrance.
questions.explanation: Give a clear location using a complete sentence.

questions.question: If I were you, I ___ apologise.
questions.explanation: If I were you is followed by would for advice.

questions.question: We ___ here since 2022.
questions.explanation: Since gives a starting point; the present perfect connects the past to now.

questions.question: Choose the correct plural of 'child'.
questions.explanation: Children is the irregular plural of child.

questions.question: If it rains, we ___ indoors.
questions.explanation: The first conditional uses if + present simple, will + base verb.

questions.question: This is the woman ___ helped me.
It ___ rain later; take an umbrella.
The weather can ___ your travel plans.
questions.explanation: Affect is usually a verb meaning to influence.
